_comment: Passed to uvicorn via --log-config (Dockerfile CMD). Replaces uvicorn's default config, which attaches its own plain-text handlers with propagate=false -- those handlers would bypass the app's formatter and mix a second format into the stream (docs/logging/spec.md). Keeping uvicorn's own handlers off is all this file decides: app/core/logging.py :: setup_custom_logger runs at import and settles propagation itself, leaving uvicorn.access alone off, since TraceContextMiddleware writes the per-request line. Lines uvicorn emits before that import fall back to logging.lastResort on stderr.
